leadText: Kimi (Japanese: ヒソカ Hisoka) is a character in the Pokémon Adventures manga. She is Drayden's secretary.
plainText:
Kimi (Japanese: ヒソカ Hisoka) is a character in the Pokémon Adventures manga. She is Drayden's secretary.

==History==
=== ===
Kimi debuted in Tooth and Claw, having arranged for a media event on Drayden's behalf despite her misgivings on Drayden's intentional omission on the event's details. She then appeared during the event itself in A Cold Reception, informing Drayden of another meeting and giving him a pretext to leave the media after announcing the opening of the Pokémon League in one week. Internally, Drayden admits that bringing the League forward is a gambit meant to force Team Plasma out of hiding; despite Drayden's gruff demeanor, Kimi points out Drayden's caring side by reminding him that he's also made arrangements to ensure the safety of the spectators.

Following the start of the Pokémon League tournament in Dream a Little Dream, Kimi witnessed confronting Drayden in a last-ditch attempt to collect enough Badges to qualify, and covered for Drayden and Black as they had an impromptu battle in Hallway Hijinks while making sure that the opening ceremony proceeded without interruption.

In Iris's flashback, Kimi was shown to have accompanied Drayden on his trip to Blackthorn City, and revealed Drayden's interest in having Iris succeed him as Gym Leader.

Following the reveal and subduing of Zinzolin at the League in True Friends, Kimi helped Drayden contain the crowd and confirm Zinzolin's arrest. She continued to hold custody of Zinzolin in Cold Hard Truth, assuring Black that Drayden and Iris had evacuated all the spectators, but was unable to stop Zinzolin from activating Team Plasma's Castle.

=== ===
Kimi appeared in Giant Chasm to help evacuate the citizens of Opelucid City who were frozen or trapped in their homes from Team Plasma's attack. She advised Drayden to head for the final battle, only to be rejected as Drayden affirmed his need to help the people as a politician.

Kimi does not have any of her own.

==Names==
